name: Bitchat
author: Derek Ross
description: Chat on the bitchat Bluetooth mesh from the Omarchy bar: peers in range on the bar, #mesh in the panel. Talks to the same bitchat apps on Android and iOS. Needs the bitchatd daemon: run dist/install.sh.

barWidget.description: bitchat mesh chat: peers in range on the bar, #mesh in the popup.

schema.label: Notifications
schema.description: mentions = only messages with @yourname. Never while the panel is open.

schema.label: Show peer count on the bar
Keep chat history
schema.description: Save the last 500 #mesh messages so they survive a restart. Off deletes the saved history.
